description:
For a capability TunnelMind does not provide itself, returns the destination's
endpoint and schema URL from a reviewed catalog, plus facts TunnelMind
itself observed: when its own probe last reached the destination, whether the
destination advertises x402 or Web Bot Auth, and the origin ASN and RPKI state
of the host. Every fact carries `{value, tier, source}` and a coverage state.
The response carries a signed Receipt v1.0.
The signature attests what TunnelMind recorded, not that the destination's
claims are true. TunnelMind never calls the destination on your behalf and
never carries your traffic or data to it. Payment always goes to
TunnelMind's own x402 address and nothing the destination says can change that.
Priced per call in x402 USDC by the caller's monthly tier (anonymous callers
pay the base price); the 402 challenge quotes the price for this call. Demo
payments are refused. When the paid tools flag is off the route answers 503
and issues no challenge. Unknown capabilities answer 404 with no charge.

X-PAYMENT.description: base64(JSON) x402 payment. Absent on the first call, which returns the 402 challenge.

capability.description: Capability slug from the referral catalog, for example whois_history.
